appStore.name: Lissom: Yoga & Mobility
appStore.subtitle: Hatha, Yin, Vinyasa and more
appStore.promotionalText: Five written yoga courses: Hatha, Ashtanga foundations, supported Yin, standing Vinyasa and chair/office yoga. Lessons in 14 languages, practice records on your device.

playStore.shortDescription: 120 written lessons in five yoga courses, with practice records on your device.

description:
Lissom offers five original written yoga courses with 120 lessons; the interface and lessons are available in 14 languages.

• Hatha: 60 lessons in 10 modules – natural breathing, preparation, supported postures, controlled transitions and independent session planning.
• Ashtanga beginner foundations: 19 lessons in 5 modules, with standing adaptations, traditional Sun A/B maps, four standing fundamentals and closing rest. This is not the full Primary Series.
• Supported Yin: 12 lessons.
• Supported standing Vinyasa: 14 lessons, with an optional knees-down floor extension.
• Chair/office yoga: 15 lessons.

Choose comfortable support, chair or rest options. Each lesson includes a learning goal, practice task, self-check and teaching sources. The movement-test catalogue also explains Overhead Reach, Deep Squat and Active Straight Leg Raise.

Read the lessons, follow the practice tasks, review your own practice and continue from your local lesson record. You can browse without signing in and use an optional shared Motion account. The account uses your email address, account ID and optional display name; account deletion is available in the app. Course records stay on the device within the current guest or account scope. Practice progress is self-recorded, not a posture grade, and no lesson completion certifies mastery. Demonstration video is not included.

Subscription: the first part of every course is free (47 of the 120 lessons). A Lissom subscription or a Motion+ subscription (shared across the five Motion apps), each monthly or yearly, unlocks the remaining lessons; new subscribers get a 14-day free trial. Prices and periods are shown by the App Store or Google Play before purchase, and you can restore or manage the subscription in the app. Payment is charged to your App Store or Google Play account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or cancelled in your store account settings. Deleting the Motion account does not cancel a store subscription.

Camera assessments are not open. General information and adaptations do not provide individual rehabilitation or prenatal treatment. Lissom is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.
